notes.title: Patch Updates v1.03
notes.content:
Happy summer! How is everyone doing?

Here comes the 3rd patch together with a 20% this month!

[h3]Patch v1.03[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new opening cutscene and level title introduction
[*] Added uncap FPS setting
[*] Added watchtowers enemy with troll archers
[*] Added (slight) deadzone area to controller joystick
[*] Added exp spawning when the first troll boss is defeated
-----
[*] Fixed missing UI button when remapping keys to side mouse buttons
[*] Fixed player accidentally throwing weapons when trying to pick up items
[*] Fixed skills and stats resources sometimes being unobtainable when player moves too fast
[*] Fixed a bug where player head could get stuck in mid-air
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera is unable to untarget in the final level
[*] Fixed a bug where flying lego vehicle continues to follow player after dismount
[*] Fixed a bug where player gets stuck when alien boss grabs player and stagger from injury.
[*] Fixed a bug where defeat UI could still be opened after Demon boss is defeated
[*] Fixed video cutscene audio volume not following audio setting
[*] Fixed Clouds platform not respawning in Treeboss fight
-----
[*] Improved UI hinting system during critical moments
[*] Improved chances of player's light-range projectiles hitting smaller targets
[*] Improved boundary placement to prevent players from going out of bounds and getting lost or stuck
[*] Improved some trees and ground textures
[*] Improved Death's reaction to give better hints on how they work
-----
[*] Reduced Orge's attack speed
[*] Changed default weapon switch control mapping from joystick L3 to D-pad
[*] Increased gamepad camera default move speed
[*] Rebalanced platforming area with Frogs
[/list]

Once again, if you have any suggestions, questions, or comments, don't hesitate to reach out to me in the [url=https://discord.gg/sz8zBN4Dcj]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1679510/discussions/]Forums[/url]!

Best,
Fishwind

notes.title: Patch Updates v1.02
notes.content:
Dear plushie adventurers,

Here comes the 2nd patch notes!

[h3]General Fixes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Locked aim cursor when performing camera lock
[*] Fixed some Japanese localization errors (Thanks to koumu5611!)
[*] Increased Player's range projectile fly speed by 17%
[/olist]

[h3]Forest level & Sleepywood fight[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Improved many enemy animations, VFX, and environment textures.
[*] Nerfed the frog-packed area on the 2nd level
[*] Slightly increased the collectible ghost during the sleepywood fight
[*] Slightly increased the vertical wind to help players get up onto the clouds in sleepywood fight
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck when falling after beating the sleepywood fight
[/olist]

[h3]Cave level & Demonlord fight[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed strange fire SFX after the lava area
[*] Fixed some paths to prevent players from going the wrong way during platforming
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get pushed down the terrain in Phase 1 Demonlord
[*] Increased the duration of ground fire from demonlord for players to ignite
[/olist]

[h3]Toy level[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug to prevent players from getting stuck around Tower's walls
[*] Fixed strange camera damping during the UFO fight on the rising elevator
[*] Fixed a bug where the UFO boss would fly too high or low
[*] Removed the death fall at the purple elephant puzzle area
[*] Added breadcrumb to improve navigation
[/olist]

Not all fixes are listed here. Big thanks to those who reported the bugs! If you find new ones or have suggestions, don't hesitate to reach out in the [url=https://discord.gg/sz8zBN4Dcj]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1679510/discussions/]Forums[/url]!

More to come soon!

Regards,
Fishwind

notes.title: Patch Updates v1.01
notes.content:
Dear plushie gamers,

[h2]Here comes the first patch notes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed Camera incorrect rotation when untargeting
[*] Fixed cutscene not in fullscreen for screens with narrower aspect ratio
[*] Fixed tutorial UI not closing when using certain controller
[*] Fixed treasure chest achievement when starting new game +
[*] Fixed Troll archer arrow can bypass terrain
[*] Fixed Vsync setting not saved after game relaunch
[*] Fixed some UIs overlapping in Toy level
[*] Fixed mummy knockback causes gravity to turn off forever
[*] Fixed Troll boss getting stuck when player triggers it at the edge of arena
[*] Rebalanced UFO boss
[*] Prevent smaller props getting camera locked unintentionally
[*] Added auto controller detection when game launches
[*] Reduce chances of unintentional item pickups or weapon being thrown
[*] Many other smaller miscellaneous
[/list]

And that's all for now. If you find bugs or issues, feel free to share it in the [url=https://discord.gg/sz8zBN4Dcj]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1679510/discussions/1/]Forums[/url]. Thank you and have fun gaming!

Regards,
Fishwind

notes.title: Pfts is coming to Steam's next fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Helloo friends, gamers and human,[/h3]

《Plushie from the Sky》will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 

During this event, you can watch our [b]pre-recorded live stream[/b] to get an idea of the gameplay! Or you can explore the game by yourself.

[b]A new demo is now available[/b] with a couple of bug fixes, balance changes, clearer ui/ux indication, animations and controller improvement.

Feel free to[b] join the discord[/b] if you have any idea, feedback, opinion, criticism, suggestion or just want a Chat :)
